_instructions: answerable: true = the answer is in the filing; false = it should NOT be (correct output is a refusal / 'Insufficient data').

evidence_snippet is an exact phrase from the filing text. Compare after collapsing all whitespace runs to a single space on BOTH the chunk text and the snippet (the filing has long runs of spaces inside tables).

Retrieval hit = normalized snippet appears in any of the top_k chunks. Answer correct = generated answer agrees with expected_answer. Refusal correct = on answerable:false, the system declines instead of answering.
'note' fields explain traps and weak questions. Answers were extracted from the saved filing text, so spot-check them against the file before treating them as final.

alt_snippets: other exact phrases in the filing that also answer the question (added after the first retrieval run showed the single-snippet metric was too narrow for questions answered in several places). Reports show a strict score (primary snippet only) and a lenient score (primary or any alternate). Alternates were chosen from the filing text, not from what the app retrieved.

filing.note: Pin this exact file. The app fetches the latest filing, so live results change when a new one is filed.

questions.question: What was total revenue for the quarter, and how did it compare with the same quarter last year?
questions.expected_answer: Total net sales were $200,606 million in Q2 2026 versus $167,702 million in Q2 2025, an increase of 20%.
questions.evidence_snippet: Sales increased 20% in Q2 2026, and 18% for the six months ended June 30, 2026 compared to the comparable prior year periods.

questions.question: What was net income for the quarter?
questions.expected_answer: Net income was $62,647 million in Q2 2026 versus $18,164 million in Q2 2025.
questions.note: Most of the increase comes from other income (expense), net of $53.4 billion, mainly upward adjustments to the Anthropic investment (see MD&A, Other Income). A good answer should not present it as operating improvement.

questions.question: What was the gross margin percentage, and what does the filing say drove the change?
questions.evidence_snippet: We believe that operating income is a more meaningful measure than gross profit and gross margin due to the diversity of our product categories and services.

Correct behavior: say it is not reported (optionally offer operating income: $27,461 million vs $19,171 million). Consider swapping this question for an operating-income question if you want 9 plain lookups.

questions.question: What does the filing say about tariffs, trade restrictions, or other macro headwinds?
questions.expected_answer: Two points. (1) Risk-factor language lists tariff policy changes and trade disputes among macro risks. (2) In Q2 2026 the company received about $640 million of tariff refunds under IEEPA, recorded mainly as a reduction to cost of sales and mostly in North America, described as the significant majority of refunds it expects to receive.
